about: What the wrap-up should keep or drop, in English and pt-PT. Run with: npm run eval:memory. 'keep' passes if a kept add/update contains `includes` (case-insensitive); 'delete' if a delete is kept; 'nothing' if no add, update or delete is kept. With "history": "none", the case also fails if any history line is kept. Opt-out cases (não guardes, off the record, …) must keep nothing at all and make no model call.
